dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acute cerebellar infarction (ischaemic stroke) — most likely in the PICA or SCA territory

Alternatives:
1. Cerebellar haemorrhage
2. Demyelinating lesion (multiple sclerosis) involving the cerebellum or brainstem
3. Cerebellar mass lesion (primary or metastatic tumour)
